note: Percentages and per-share prices only. Never store dollar amounts or share counts in this file: the repository is public.

positions.name: Altria
positions.exitPlan: Sell on a dividend cut, or if cigarette volumes fall more than about 8% a year without price increases to offset them.

positions.name: Coca-Cola
positions.exitPlan: Sell if organic growth is below 3% for two quarters in a row, or if North American volumes decline.

positions.name: Alphabet (Class C)
positions.exitPlan: Sell if search revenue growth turns negative, or if Cloud operating margin falls while capex keeps rising.

positions.name: JPMorgan Inflation Managed Bond ETF
positions.exitPlan: Keep at 5% to 10%. Switch to plain Treasuries if CPI runs below 2.5% for three months.

positions.name: UnitedHealth Group
positions.exitPlan: Sell if the medical care ratio goes back above 90% excluding reserve releases, or if 2027 EPS guidance comes in below $22.

positions.name: Cheniere Energy
positions.exitPlan: Sell on a cut to cash flow guidance, or if new long-term contracting stalls as the 2027 to 2028 LNG supply wave arrives.

positions.name: ServiceNow
positions.exitPlan: Sell if subscription revenue or current remaining performance obligations grow less than 15%.

positions.name: Celestica
positions.exitPlan: Sell if a major hyperscaler cuts capex, or if 2027 revenue guidance comes in below 2026. The first position to cut if a contraction starts.

positions.name: Enterprise Products Partners
positions.exitPlan: Sell on a distribution cut, or if distribution coverage falls below 1.3 times.

positions.name: State Street Blackstone High Income ETF
positions.exitPlan: Keep at 0% to 5%. Sell it all if two of the four contraction signals on the cycle tracker fire, or if high-yield spreads widen sharply.

positions.name: Nvidia
positions.exitPlan: Sell if any hyperscaler guides 2027 capex flat or down, or if gross margin falls below 70%.

positions.name: Vanguard FTSE Europe ETF
positions.exitPlan: Keep at 3% to 6%. Trim back to 6% if it grows past it.

positions.name: Bank of America
positions.exitPlan: Sell if return on tangible equity is below 12% excluding one-offs, or if expenses outgrow revenue for two more quarters.

positions.name: JPMorgan Chase
positions.exitPlan: Sell if return on tangible equity falls below 15%, or if net charge-offs rise quickly.

positions.name: SPDR S&P Biotech ETF
positions.exitPlan: Keep at 2% to 5%. Trim back to 5% if it grows past it; review if the Fed keeps hiking into 2027.

positions.name: First Solar
positions.exitPlan: Sell if the backlog falls below 35 GW, or if the Section 45X credits change.

positions.name: TMC the metals company
positions.exitPlan: Sell it all on a permit denial or a ruling that blocks US seabed mining. Keep it under 2% of the portfolio.
